idleWindowStatement: Reserved local window after QA/HMR/development CSS diagnostics ended; no concurrent local builds, tests, browsers or compression; integral CI is remote; OS and thermal state uncontrolled.

conditions.timer: Fresh Node process for every build; elapsed wall time from spawn to close.
conditions.caches: Fresh output/cacheDir and verified checkout-local .vite-temp cleared per build. OS filesystem cache is warm/uncontrolled, not cold. No persistent production compiler cache is assumed.
conditions.temporaryFiles: Each child receives fresh checkout-local TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR below its report directory.
conditions.phases: Initial pairs are retained and reported separately from repeated pairs. No discarded warmup builds. Repeated means repetition in new processes, not a warm compiler.
conditions.compression: Deferred until all timed builds finish; each unique raw SHA256 compressed once with common parameters; totals sum separately compressed resources.
conditions.inference: Descriptive local samples only; no population confidence claim or automatic adoption threshold.

installation.evidence: See accompanying frozen-install and dependency-diff records.

conditions.backend: No browser/backend is invoked. envDir=false and synthetic Supabase public values point to loopback port 9.

parameters.cssRules: PostCSS walkRules node count, including nested and keyframe rules; not unique selectors or utility classes
